residuals.observation: Explanation still appears around 11–12 pixels high; access/care line is around 9–10. Comfortable reading requires more caption area.
A new separator middle dot is inserted between the complete access entry and the complete care entry.
The top panorama remains around 38% of poster height, the left view around 31% of width and the care view stays tall. The wider-caption structural adjustment was not implemented.
Warm greens and yellow dominate; the stronger indigo/plum masses remain limited.

observations.observation: The original invitation now appears once as the largest two-line serif copy; the duplicated central slogan has been removed.
Korean title, Latin companion and slogan remain together at the window-leaf view's lower edge.
Leaves, rooted ball and open-pot/hands structure remain legible with controlled faceted painting edges.
Invitation is immediately above four-line explanation. A short step and rule lead to market/date/hours/venue; URL now immediately follows access/care.
Invitation is the clear main type anchor inside the unequal image frame; panorama and right care image retain their earlier large proportions.

style.requirement: Unequal rectilinear painted sequence, central invitation leading through explanation into visit details, quiet left identity and deep indigo/plum/green/honey
observed_limits: Care view is tall, not square
style.default_exclusion_observation: Substantive botanical and hand-care views organize the whole scene frame; this is an image-led sequence rather than tiny imagery on a passive headline template. The oversized invitation and restricted body space still compromise intended hierarchy.

substantive_visual.observation: Window plant life, market selection and root-ball repotting remain substantial content-grounded scenes.

hangul.observation: Native explanation has coherent square forms, open counters and meaningful word spaces. At usage720 small body size weakens sustained reading.

information_relationship.observation: The intended invitation → prose → event/visit → access/care → URL ordering is now local, but the compressed access/care row is small.

function_contact.observation: URL visibly reads leaves.example/market; external function is not tested.

material_edge_finish.observation: Root fibres, clay rim, supporting hand and stem attachments remain convincing; scene boundaries are straight. Brush facets are visible, though rendering remains naturalistic.
